title: [GMCP 203.026.M] Mastery: OAuth-capable MCP client and authorization flow
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-026-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: The host completes secure authorization-code flows with PKCE, state and nonce binding, protected-resource discovery, authorization-server selection, exact redirect matching, refresh rotation, revocation, incremental scopes and per-resource credential binding. Dynamic registration is isolated as legacy policy; current client metadata mechanisms, loopback hardening, browser cancellation and concurrent-account flows are interoperable and attack-tested. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
